app_tagline: [नेपाली] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [नेपाली] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [नेपाली] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [नेपाली] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [नेपाली] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [नेपाली] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.

caste_why: [नेपाली] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [नेपाली] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [नेपाली] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [नेपाली] Your recordings have reached a helper
